title: Term Commitment Share Schedule for Lease Term Agreement Concession Recapture
content:
The concession recapture booked on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement keeps a commitment share of the unearned concession. The commitment share is set by the length of the term, counted in days from its start date through its end date with both days included: 480 days or more keeps 80 percent; 395 to 479 days keeps 90 percent; fewer than 395 days keeps the whole.

| Length of the term (start and end dates included) | Commitment share kept |
|---|---|
| 480 days or more | 80 percent (0.80) |
| 395 to 479 days | 90 percent (0.90) |
| fewer than 395 days | the whole (100 percent) |

The share multiplies the unearned concession, and no figure is rounded before the recapture itself.

**Boundary lengths.** 394 days keeps the whole and 395 days keeps 90 percent; 479 days keeps 90 percent and 480 days keeps 80 percent.

**Hypothetical terms.** A term from 15 March to 14 March of the next non-leap year runs 365 days: the whole. A term from 1 January to 31 January of the next non-leap year runs 396 days: 90 percent. A term from 1 January to 30 April of the next non-leap year runs 485 days: 80 percent.
